stem.text: A student wrote the following statements about a possible mechanism for loading sucrose from a source.

items: When energy is released from ATP, the released energy is used to move sucrose through a co-transporter protein in the companion cell membrane.
As sucrose is moved into a companion cell the pH in the cell wall of the companion cell decreases.
Proton pumps in the cell membrane of a companion cell move sucrose into the phloem sieve tube element.
